postQA42Commits.author: Nazar Ukolov
postQA42Commits.subject: feat(courier): fly a real accepted contract to the destination and mail the issuer
postQA42Commits.body:
Live dispatch now resumes an IN_PROGRESS contract whose acceptor is one of our seeded pilots: the courier returns to the origin, undocks, warps, docks at the destination and completes natively. Without this the accepted cargo sat in the hangar forever after a restart.

Fixes found against the live server: gameStore.read returns {success,data} and keys are bare IDs (every pilot looked like a non-identity), item rows come from the same store, the courier session needs a no-op sendSessionChange or the native undock throws after mutating real state, warps must use startSessionlessWarpIngress (space.warpToPoint expects a client session and silently did nothing), a real EveJS package sits in the issuer's office location until accepted, and an interrupted undock leaves stationID null plus a hull pointing at the solar system - repaired through the store, never by faking a flight.

Notices are real native EVEmail from the courier character to the issuer: accepted, departing, delivered.
